log.query:
chore(rebrand): flip user-facing Arc → Sigilix in response bodies and prompts

## Summary

Caught while testing on the live Worker — every user-visible string still called the bot "Arc". The bot's display name was already updated (`sigilix[bot]` after the App rename) but the strings *inside* the comments and responses lagged behind.

## What flipped to "Sigilix"

**Response bodies (visible on every PR comment / health check):**
- `src/index.ts` — root `/` health response: `"Arc Worker — alive"` → `"Sigilix — alive"`
- `src/lib/triage-pr-overview.ts` — `"## Arc Overview"` → `"## Sigilix Overview"`
- `src/lib/triage-pr-review.ts` — `"### Arc Summary"` (in both `formatReviewBody` and `buildFallbackBody`) → `"### Sigilix Summary"`
- `src/lib/triage-ci.ts` — footer `"Auto-triage by Arc"` → `"Auto-triage by Sigilix"`

**LLM system prompts (the model's self-identification — affects how it talks about itself):**
- `src/prompts/pr-review.ts`, `pr-overview.ts`, `ci-triage.ts`, `mention-reply.ts`, `agent-system.ts`, `issue-triage.ts`, `github-mention.ts` — all 7 flipped from `"You are **Arc**"` → `"You are **Sigilix**"`. Plus inline references (e.g., `arc re-reviews on the new SHA` → `Sigilix re-reviews`, the `@arc` example in `github-mention.ts`'s negative-rule list → `@sigilix`).

**Tests updated** to assert against the new strings: `triage-pr-review.test.ts`, `submit-review-fallback.test.ts`, `triage-pr-overview.test.ts`.

## What stays as legacy (intentionally)

- `src/lib/mention.ts` — `DEFAULT_TRIGGERS` still includes `arc`, `arc-copilot`, `openclaw` for back-compat. Historical PR threads that @-mention old names continue to trigger the bot.
- HTML dedupe markers `<!-- openclaw:pr-review -->`, `<!-- openclaw:pr-overview -->`, etc. — content-based dedupe; changing them would post duplicate comments on existing PRs.
- Internal function names (`isArcGithubLogin`, `arcInThreadAbove`) — not user-visible.
- Internal comments / docstrings mentioning the historical brand — not customer-facing.

## Tests

481 pass; typecheck clean.

## Test plan

- [x] All 481 existing tests pass
- [x] `triage-pr-review.test.ts` asserts on new "Sigilix Summary" header
- [x] `submit-review-fallback.test.ts` (both assertions) updated
- [x] `triage-pr-overview.test.ts` asserts on new "Sigilix Overview" header
- [ ] Post-merge: confirm next PR review on the live Worker uses "Sigilix Summary" / "Sigilix Overview" headers in posted comments
- [ ] Confirm next CI failure triage uses "Auto-triage by Sigilix" footer

Follow-up to PR #39 (the visible-surface rename).
